sources.title: ExxonMobil
sources.snippet: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation is an American multinational oil and gas corporation headquartered in Spring, Texas, a suburb of Houston. Founded as the largest direct successor of John D. Rockefeller
ExxonMobil scientists are pioneering new research & technologies to reduce emissions. Learn how we are responsibly meeting the world's energy needs.
ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation is a holding company whose direct, wholly owned subsidiary and principal operating company is Exxon Mobil Corporation
